label: PRE-TREE BASELINE

comparability.opponent_model: top-8 by adjusted_adp, rand()*rand() index weighting
comparability.note: A tree measured against a DIFFERENT board or opponent model is not comparable to this. Re-freeze the baseline on the new board first, or the diff measures the board rather than the tree.

the_question: When the decision tree lands, re-run and diff. Same rate and same magnitude => the tree made existing behaviour legible. Different rate or magnitude => the tree CHANGED recommendations, and that change must be justified on its own evidence rather than inherited from the restructure.
